name: desire for quiet
quote: I need to get out of this crazy place.
description: Physical or mental need for stillness.
perceptions: The body wants to rest, or the mind wants to experience stillness.

comparisons.description: Being 'overwhelmed' doesn't necessarily mean you desire quiet - it can mean you're feeling unable to process so much at once and would like to cut back some.
Wanting quiet does not necessarily mean you're sleepy.

commentaries.quote: Silence is the sanctuary of the soul.

Introverted folks tend to be more sensitive and therefore use quiet, isolation, and reflection to regulate their stimulation to a comfortable level. Extroverts, conversely, tend to be less sensitive and therefore need more excitement and interaction to reach their ideal levels of stimulation.
commentaries.attribution: Susan Cain in 'Quiet: The Power of Introverts in a World That Can’t Stop Talking'
